# Product

## Goal
Provide a tiny notes API.

## Target users
Single-user local developers.

## User problems
Need durable notes.

## Expected behavior
Users can create and complete notes.

## Important flows
Create, list, complete.

## Constraints
Local-only V1.

## Scope
Notes only.

## Non-goals
No collaboration.

## Accepted product decisions
- Product behavior is intentionally minimal.

## Unresolved product questions
None for frontier F-001.
